section.p: De-identification is the process of removing or altering personally identifiable information so that individuals or institutions cannot easily be identified. Since AI is not secure it's highly important that information is de-identified when entering it into any AI model.

When It comes to students data privacy its essential to ensure that any information about the student is removed. Ensure that all names, nicknames and initials have been removed. Confirm that any information like student Id number, email address, phone number, and street address have been removed. Additionally dates like birth dates or enrollment dates should also be removed or replaced with a random number.
